newsitem.title: UK: LME metals edge lower during evening session.
newsitem.headline: LME metals edge lower during evening session.

text.p: Copper prices edged lower on the London Metal Exchange during Wednesday's late session in fairly quiet business, traders said.
The red metal recovered from an earlier dip under $2,470 on the kerb but it slipped again later so that by 1800 GMT, three months copper was indicated at $2,467/$2,471 versus a kerb close at $2,478.
Aluminium was barely changed from the kerb close having been steadier than copper all day. It was indicated at $1,587/$1,590, down $2.00 from the kerb.
The other metals were little changed and nickel did not capitalise on its earlier gains made on the prospect of a long strike at Inco's Sudbury complex.
